unmasked.rule: Each explicit narrative percentage, raw-weight value, horizon, date/period or numeric range is one occurrence; a range or date interval is one occurrence. Repeats in different fields count again. Citation/sector/stage identifier digits and bare structural weights are excluded. The one2% Real Estate occurrence also states equality to D0 and is not double-counted.

fresh.rule: One located assertion occurrence about subject/metric/value-or-direction/unit/period. A prior/final weight pair and change direction count as one process assertion; a policy range counts as one assertion. Repetitions at different output locations remain separate occurrences. One sentence with two sector subjects produces two subject-specific claims. Structured proposed weights are separate from prose weight-pair claims. Direction/sign and duration relation claims are included and labeled.
